coverage_gaps.reason: SPI has no SQL planner, typed relational schema, joins or SQL transactional workload API. A BYTEA KV comparison does not validate this domain.
SPI has no integrated typed columnar aggregation/join executor. Historical kernels are not the durable DB interface.
No SPI text-index/query/ranking API yet. Cannot fabricate feature-equivalent output.
No SPI vector query/index API yet. Exact and approximate contracts would need separate benchmarks.
SPI is currently single-node. Distributed failure, replication and network costs are not implemented.
No validated adapter in this first campaign. This roster is representative, not every available database.

scope: Representative native KV-operation comparison. Engine lifecycle and cache metrics are qualified, not one overall score.
